problem_statement:
feat(browser): drive an installed Chrome/Edge/Brave instead of downloading Chromium

Playwright's own bundled Chromium (~150-300MB via `playwright install
chromium`) was the actual weight in the browser tool, not the library.
_find_system_browser() now auto-detects an already-installed
Chromium-based browser (Chrome, Edge, Brave -- checked via PATH lookup
on Linux, common install paths on Windows/macOS) and launches that via
Playwright's executable_path, falling back to Playwright's bundled
Chromium only when nothing is found (and to a clear actionable error
if that isn't installed either). WELLS_BROWSER_EXECUTABLE pins an
exact path if auto-detection picks the wrong browser.

Verified live: detected the system Chrome install, drove it end-to-end
(navigate/read), confirmed via the actual running process list that
it was genuinely the system binary (not ms-playwright's cache), and
confirmed clean teardown with no orphaned processes -- all without
ever touching Playwright's own Chromium download.
